title: dev29 real-authority intention and instrumentation rebase
summary: Rebases bounded performance observation and specialist intention discovery onto the real dev28 source authority without weakening mutation or security boundaries.
invariants: Instrumentation is observation-only and contains no SQL/source text or credentials.
Intention federation is advisory; execution re-enters the secure Examiner.
Resource materialisation is set-based rather than per-object/per-resource.
Architecture Intentions remains external design authority; SSC independently verifies source/closure evidence.
